purpose: Track external datasets before any raw download, transformation, or merge into AcuTing OS.

import_policy.source_checked_rule: Do not mark source_checked until checked against institutional databases, professional textbooks, WHO/official standards, or Ting-approved school materials.
import_policy.medical_claim_rule: Use conservative wording such as related documentation context, associated with, traditional pattern relationship, or review prompt. Do not state efficacy or replacement of biomedical diagnosis.

sources.name: Mengqi97/chinese-medical-dataset
sources.notes: Use as an index only. Each upstream dataset needs its own license and access review.

sources.name: TCM-NER Chinese medicine package-insert entity recognition dataset
sources.notes: Not a formula canon source. Keep any future import draft and do not treat as clinical truth.

sources.name: TCM-QG Chinese medicine literature question generation dataset
sources.notes: Useful for learning tools, not canonical formula composition or indications.

sources.name: Chinese formula knowledge-base candidate
sources.notes: Needed before bulk formula import. Do not import formula content until source URL, access terms, and field quality are confirmed.

sources.name: HKBU Chinese Medicine Formulae Images Database
sources.notes: Use for cross-checking and citations, not bulk scraping.
